main_text.head: In Τεχνομετρείαν Magni Theologi & Philosophi D. D.G. Amesii.

p.i: Uc usque turpi nubilo pressum caput,
Et tota dispar, membra ducebat suis
Nunc illa verum monstra ridemus, chaos
Et fida solers jura singulis dedit

page.notes: The H of the opening line is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to "Huc". Greek title in Greek letters as printed. Some letters in the lower lines are partly obscured by the scan edge; "Cæcumque" and "pondus" read with some doubt. The right-hand edge shows only fragments of marginal text ("manif", "3.", "terræ", "vertit") which are cut off and not fully legible. The right margin is cut off at the scan edge; only fragments are legible (e.g. "artifi", "ta, ut", "4.", "prop", "habe", "nimi", "natu", "agen", "illa f", "domi", "idea", "5.", "plna", "neral", "expr", "comp", "nien", "6.").
